text:
Staff reviews collect the feedback venue
managers give your staff after a shift.

This tutorial uses fictional demonstration
data.

Open Users, and select View on a staff
member.

Open the More menu beside the tabs, and
choose Staff reviews.

Overall rating shows the average score,
and how the reviews are spread from one to

Average by category breaks the score down
into grooming, attitude, skills,

Use the venue manager and date range
filters to narrow the reviews, for example

Review history lists each review. Select
View review to see the full shift review.

The shift review shows each category score
and any written feedback. Reviews are read
